name: Float Bar
summary: A floating toolbar that springs to the words you select: bold, three highlighters, links and margin notes
about: Select any words in a draft and a dark glass toolbar pops out of the selection, its buttons popping in one after another, then springs after the selection as it changes. Bold and italic ink in with a glow, highlighters sweep across like a real marker, a link turns the bar into an address field, and a note pins a numbered card in the margin with a dotted line back to its words. Undo steps back through every change.
how: Drag across words with a mouse or finger, or hold Shift and use the arrow keys.
Pick Bold, Italic, a highlighter, Link, Note or Copy; press the same style again to remove it.
Shortcuts: Ctrl or Cmd with B, I or K; Alt+F10 moves focus into the toolbar.
Use Undo to step back and Clear all to start again.
A demo pointer selects and styles words by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
